sources.title: Run YOLOv8-pose on RK3588 | reComputer AI Lab
sources.snippet: Post-processing: YOLOv8-Pose specific Box decoding, NMS logic, and Keypoint extraction. Visualization: Draws bounding boxes and pose skeletons with customized colors. Modifying Models Place the trained and converted .rknn model into the model/ directory. Add the --model_path argument to the running command to point to the new model.

sources.title: yolov8-pose command - github.com/swdee/go-rknnlite/example/yolov8-pose ...
sources.snippet: Note that these examples are only using a single NPU core to run inference on. The results would be different when running a Pool of models using all NPU cores available. Secondly the Rock 4D (rk3576) has DDR5 memory versus the Rock 5B (rk3588) with slower DDR4 memory. Background This YOLOv8-pose example is a Go conversion of the C API example.
